public_domain_references.web: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
public_domain_references.asv: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
public_domain_references.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, [and] how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

pob.text: I sent him to you for this very purpose: that you may know how we are[a], and that he may encourage your hearts.

spob.text: I sent him to you for exactly this reason: so you can learn how we are doing[a] and he can encourage your hearts.

public_domain_references.bsb: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
public_domain_references.web: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
public_domain_references.asv: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and [that] he might comfort your hearts.

pob.text: Peace to the brothers[a], and love with faith[c][b], from God the Father and the Lord Jesus the Messiah.

spob.text: May God the Father and the Lord Jesus the Messiah[c] give peace to the brothers[a], and love together with faith.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.web: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.asv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: Peace [be] to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

pob.text: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus the Messiah with incorruptibility[a].

spob.text: May grace be with everyone who loves our Lord Jesus the Messiah with an imperishable love.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
